scope.graph_discovery: Graph tools were not exposed; scoped source, diff, caller and contract reads were used.

finding_assessment.basis: Failure results no longer serialize credential-bearing command/stderr/exception/provider bodies; all failure regressions and valid/no-key controls pass.

Both distributed copies bind name plus recursively typed canonical value, use separated domains, version their seals and seal the final body; old ambiguity and subsequent body mutation regressions reject.

A coherent trusted-key signed fixture verifies, while editable legacy checksums, altered/missing evidence, unknown key, absent/invalid signature, malformed schema and current-state mismatches reject. This is functional authenticated verification, not a disabled-verifier mitigation.
CLI returns nonzero for failed verification and zero for the authorized signed fixture.

resolved_review_findings.title: Emit silently ignored explicit verification inputs
resolved_review_findings.initial_observation: The initial patch accepted --emit with evidence-path/expected-state flags, returned 0 and called the default generator, ignoring the selected inputs. Reproduced with generate_attestation_statement replaced by a spy; no emission or file read occurred.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Main now leaves these parser options unset by default, applies default paths only for verification, and rejects all verify-only options when emit is selected.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Independent isolated replay now raises SystemExit(2) without calling the generator; seven flag regressions pass.

checks.stage: final reviewed patch and integration additions

checks.method: Independent typed-value collision and JSON roundtrip control, executed against each full SOCINT source module without main/network/vault calls.
checks.assertion: 17 distinct roots for {v: input}; verify_evidence_seal accepts JSON roundtrip of empty/one-field/three-field bodies. Altering sealed_at remains accepted, consistent with the explicitly excluded metadata scope.

checks.method: Independent topology-boundary collision control with a synthetic agents_archi module and fake list_team rosters; restored sys.modules/sys.path afterwards.
checks.assertion: compute_topology_sha256 digests differ; no real agents module imported.

checks.method: Read-only AST comparison against Git HEAD for the primary SOCINT copy, normalizing only placeholder-free f-strings and the mechanical l-to-line rename.
checks.result: No unrelated function-body changes detected after the declared mechanical normalizations.

source_checks.observation: Mail provider error bodies, stderr and exception text are excluded from returned errors. Stable codes/returncode remain; successful string IDs redact the exact configured token.
Versioned JSON/Ed25519 scope is explicit and does not claim COSE, registered SCITT or hardware attestation. The emitter is explicitly unsigned.
Compact sorted UTF-8 canonical bytes reject nonfinite numbers; duplicate JSON keys are rejected and expected digests require nonzero lowercase hex.
Failed Git lookup returns no fabricated digest; topology hashes named canonical JSON lists; selected evidence bytes are read once each for digests and the outreach root comes from the same bytes.
Unsigned emitter records current selected evidence/commit/topology and contains no fabricated audit/compliance verdict.

Verifier requires an external raw Ed25519 key, exact versioned envelope, full-body signature, compound digest, current or explicit offline expectations and recalculated evidence digests. Rejections return False.
CLI requires an explicit mode, maps verification rejection to exit 1, and now rejects every verify-only option under emit before any generator call.
Merkle v2 recursively encodes JSON types, binds field names, separates leaf/node/empty domains, publishes exact covered fields, and verifies the complete body excluding declared seal metadata.
Markdown labels legacy seals, checks v2 before displaying VERIFIED, and discloses that timestamps/metadata and authorship are outside the seal.
Producer computes network/centrality/coordinated-action fields before invoking seal_evidence.
Regression coverage includes mail transport/provider failures and valid/missing-key paths, both Merkle copies, typed/nested/order/empty/impar inputs and exact-body verification.
Attestation cases use ephemeral keys and temporary evidence, testing valid trusted signatures and key/signature/schema/JSON/evidence/commit/topology rejections plus CLI status.

Additional integration cases replace network adapters and output to temporary paths, prevent emit when verify-only flags are present, confine unsigned emission to temporary evidence, and reject failed current Git lookup.

limits: No deployment, native gate, hardware attestation, production extraction, real email or external service was exercised. The passing evidence is isolated local Python execution.
Mail credentials remain part of curl argv during actual dispatch; this review fixes and validates returned-error disclosure, not operating-system process-list confidentiality.
Merkle v2 authenticates no author by itself. Seal metadata, including sealed_at, is deliberately outside the committed body and is labeled as such. Legacy seals do not become v2.

Tamkarum trusts the caller-supplied external key and evidence/optional offline expectations. It verifies file-byte correspondence, signed body, Git commit identity and named roster lists, not campaign truth, whole-working-tree equivalence, complete agent configuration, key revocation/freshness or simultaneous multi-file snapshot atomicity.
No production signing key is created. The emitter remains unsigned; the verified success path uses temporary software keys supplied by the fixture.
MyPy, baseline before-patch regressions and global documentation gates are coordinator evidence, not independently rerun or certified by this review.
